metadata.title: A versatile genetic engineering toolkit for E. coli based on CRISPR-prime editing

reference.title: A versatile genetic engineering toolkit for E. coli based on CRISPR-prime editing

target.condition: LB, 37 °C, antibiotics per plasmid, ATc induction

trigger.observation: CRISPR base editors in bacteria are restricted to fixed single-nucleotide substitutions within a narrow window; prime editing demonstrated in human/rice/wheat cells performs search-and-replace edits without DSBs, and single-strand nicking was hypothesized to be non-lethal in NHEJ-lacking bacteria
trigger.reasoning: Build a DSB-free prime-editing toolkit for E. coli (Cas9n-M-MLV2 fusion + PEgRNA + GFP reporter on three compatible plasmids)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Adopted fusion architecture (M-MLV2 mutations, H840A nickase) was previously experimentally validated in human cells (Anzalone et al. 2019); functionality re-verified here by measured editing
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Heterologous expression of ATc-inducible Cas9n(H840A)-33aa-linker-M-MLV2 fusion; constitutive PEgRNA (J23119) and GFP reporter (J23106); compatible oris p15A/ColE1/ColDF13

result.after: Functional system; all four edit classes achieved on plasmid

decision_chain.rule: DSB-free nickase-reverse-transcriptase prime-editing architectures developed in eukaryotes are a rational starting point for bacterial hosts lacking NHEJ, provided codon optimization, inducible expression and compatible multi-plasmid delivery are re-engineered for the host

trigger.observation: Fusion protein is under an ATc-inducible promoter, so induction strength was an untuned variable expected to control editing efficiency
trigger.reasoning: Determine optimal induction condition for the ATc-driven Cas9n-M-MLV2 fusion

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Directly measured editing efficiencies across the titration in three biological replicates
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Fermentation/process condition change: 8 ATc concentrations 0–1000 ng/mL

result.metric: Non-green colony ratio per edit type
result.after: Dose-dependent induction; plateau 100–500 ng/mL; max 43.7% (1-bp del) at 1000 ng/mL; 200 ng/mL adopted as standard

trigger.observation: Initial 13+13 nt design was adopted from human-cell PE; whether these lengths are optimal in E. coli was unknown
trigger.reasoning: Define functional PBS and RTT scaffold length windows for E. coli prime editing

evidence.source_location: Baseline 13 nt PBS / 13 nt RTT scaffold design

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured insertion frequencies for each length variant
decision_chain.implementation_detail: PEgRNA component engineering: PBS 5/8/13/17 nt; RTT scaffold 4/5/8/13/20 nt

result.after: PBS window 13–17 nt; RTT optimum ~13 nt; <10 or >20 nt reduces efficiency; consistent with eukaryotic reports

trigger.observation: Practical utility for gene inactivation/promoter insertion requires knowing achievable edit sizes and their efficiency trade-off
trigger.reasoning: Systematically test insertion (3/12/18/33 bp, incl. mini-T7 promoter) and deletion (1–97 bp) capacity

evidence.source_location: Smallest edit (1-bp deletion / 3-bp insertion) as baseline

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured efficiencies per size in triplicate
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Varied edit cargo size at fixed optimal PBS/RTT and 200 ng/mL ATc

result.after: All designed events obtainable; efficiency drops sharply with size (<2% deletions ≥23 bp; <1% insertions ≥18 bp)

target.condition: Standard induction; 400 µL electroporation culture plated

trigger.observation: Reports that a second nick increased PE efficiency in mammalian and plant cells (PE3 strategy)
trigger.reasoning: Test whether a second nick in the non-edited strand (PE3-like strategy) increases editing efficiency in E. coli

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Outcome measured directly (colony lethality), though the motivating premise was literature-derived
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Addition of pnsgRNA-delivered second nicking guide paired with the PEgRNA (two strategies, Supplementary Note 1)

result.after: Almost no visible colonies; second nick is lethal, not efficiency-enhancing, in NHEJ-lacking E. coli

decision_chain.rule: PE3-style second-nick enhancement should not be transferred to bacteria lacking NHEJ without viability testing; in E. coli it causes near-complete cell death rather than efficiency gains

target.condition: X-gal LB plates (lacZ); M63 + 0.1% 2-DOG + 0.2% glycerol (galK); 200 ng/mL ATc

trigger.observation: Plasmid-target editing succeeded; chromosomal applicability in a standard K-12 strain was the outstanding question for practical strain engineering
trigger.reasoning: Validate chromosomal editing in E. coli MG1655 using selectable/screenable metabolic markers lacZ (X-gal) and galK (2-DOG)

evidence.source_location: Wild-type MG1655 on X-gal; parental MG1655 for WGS background

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured efficiencies, sequencing validation and WGS fidelity assessment
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Stop-codon introduction into lacZ (TAG insertion, GC deletion, GT→TA substitution) and galK (TAA insertion) via the 3-plasmid PE system

result.metric: White/blue colony ratio; 2-DOG resistant colonies; Sanger sequencing
result.after: lacZ efficiencies 6.8%/12.2%/26% (sub/ins/del); all sequenced clones correct; galK 4/4 correct; high on-target fidelity genome-wide

engineering_problem.problem_statement: Establish and evaluate a DSB-free CRISPR-Prime Editing genetic manipulation toolkit for E. coli capable of substitutions, deletions, insertions and combinations thereof on plasmids and the chromosome at single-nucleotide resolution, and characterize its efficiency, design parameters (ATc dose, PBS/RTT length, edit size), multiplexing ability and genome-wide fidelity.

identity.title: A versatile genetic engineering toolkit for E. coli based on CRISPR-prime editing

evidence.note: Abstract: 'we adapt a CRISPR-Prime Editing-based... toolkit for prokaryotes' — tool development framing
Original experiments: toolkit construction, plasmid/chromosome editing, characterization, WGS fidelity evaluation
Method-development claims with validation experiments; distinctions: method development (toolkit), validation experiments (GFP/lacZ/galK), application examples (multiplexing)

target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Recipient for the 3-plasmid (and 4-plasmid multiplex) PE system; used for plasmid-target editing, electroporation, CFU and growth assays; reference genome NC_010473; parental strain sequenced for background
target_strains.genotype: Wild-type lab strain + plasmids pCDF-GFPplus / pPEgRNA / pCRISPR-PE (± pVRb_PEgRNA/pnsgRNA); edited derivatives carry designed GFP-locus edits
target_strains.reasoning: Named explicitly in Results and Methods as transformation/editing host; full genotype listing deferred to Supplementary Table 1

target_strains.paper_label: MG1655 / wild type E. coli MG1655
target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: K-12 wild-type strain used for chromosomal editing of lacZ and galK; reference genome NC_U00096; 'wild type' label denotes the unedited parental MG1655 in Fig. 4b, not a separate natural isolate; known to lose the 776-bp insB1–insA fragment during cultivation (background variable mutation)
target_strains.genotype: Wild-type K-12 MG1655; edited derivatives: lacZ (TAG ins, GC del, GT→TA sub) and galK (TAA ins) stop-codon knockouts
target_strains.reasoning: Explicitly named as chromosomal editing host in Results; K-12 lineage is standard knowledge consistent with reference genome NC_U00096 used by the authors

target_system_adaptation.reason: No user target system provided in the extraction request; per skill rule, adaptation is not performed and K-12-specific tools are not invoked. Paper strains were identified independently from full text as required.
